run_turk_oncall_jobs: run oncall HITs by spinning up ECS instances with a docker image tag and timeout
run_oncall_job_data_generator: run an OnCallJob data generator that allocates ECS instances and launches Mephisto crowdwork HITs
run_task_runner_with_generators: run a TaskRunner that schedules registered data generators and job listeners to completion
allocate_oncall_ecs_instances: allocate AWS ECS instances for Turk-oncall dashboard sessions and register DNS subdomains
download_and_parse_turk_logs: download turk interaction logs from S3 and parse them into a map of agent IDs to log directories
